name: Stormbringer: Master Airbender shortens Static-spending cooldowns on Gale (#2815)
contract: Master Airbender 705719 (Spell.dbc: passive Attributes 448, Effect[0..2] APPLY_AURA / aura 42 PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL, EffectTriggerSpell 680878 / 6801879 / 681010, all TARGET_UNIT_CASTER) promises "Casting Gale now reduces the cooldown of abilities that deplete Static by $/1000;680878s1 sec", excluding Updraft and Invigorating Surge. Each trigger carries three SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_MODIFY_COOLDOWN effects with EffectBasePoints -1001 + EffectDieSides 1 = -1000 ms: 680878 names 806124 Aerodynamics, 500039 Kiss of the Clouds and 804035 Tailwind; 6801879 names 806242 Insulate, 804830 Skyfall and 500040 Call Lightning; 681010 names 705672 Exhale, 500041 Body of Lightning and 707543 Flurry. 705719's DBC ProcFlags are 0, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs skips proc-entry generation and, with no spell_proc row, none of the three triggers can ever fire. The measured targets are the ones with a real self cooldown that a solo fixture can start: Exhale (RecoveryTime 90000, target self), Insulate (RecoveryTime 60000, target self), Body of Lightning (Category 525, RecoveryTime/CategoryRecoveryTime 90000, target self) and Kiss of the Clouds rank 1 (Category 56, CategoryRecoveryTime 30000), which is learned at rank 1 so that the id named by EffectMiscValue is also the rank cast. Skyfall and Flurry are SPELL_EFFECT_FORCE_CAST on TARGET_UNIT_PET and Aerodynamics, Tailwind and Call Lightning have no cooldown at all, so neither can be measured here. Gale rank 5 (570141) carries SpellFamilyFlags0 0x4000, which matches exactly the five Gale ranks; Arm of Thorim (SpellFamilyFlags1 0x2, no mana cost) is the negative control. An identical unarmed control player casts the same spells in lockstep so ordinary cooldown decay cancels out.
